title: 心理調査法
subtitle: Psychological Survey Method
educationalGoal: Students will learn about (1)~(3) through practice. (1) How to devise psychological survey (2) How to implement psychological survey (3) How to summarize and analyze data
advice: We will cover the following topics: Pros and cons of psychological survey methods How to prepare the questionnaire and what to consider How to conduct the survey How to summarize and analyze data How to take ethical considerations into account This course is required for Certified Psychologists and Certified Public Psychologists.
books: Textbooks:None Reference books:None Reserved books:Hori, H(Eds.) (2001-) Psychological Scales Sets 1~6 SAIENSU-SHA Co., Ltd.,
requiredKnowledge: Completion of the “Elements of Psychology” and “Method of Psychological Research” courses is recommended.

activityGoals.body: Ability to be able to explain a series of procedures in psychological survey methods.
Ability to be able to explain the rationale for selecting a survey method.
Ability to be able to consider what should be taken into account when conducting psychological survey.

In addition, the student will be able to understand and practice a series of procedures in psychological survey methods. The student will be able to discuss and apply the points to be considered when conducting psychological survey in detail.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
